repos.name: kev
repos.description: tiny Jev-like family of decision models built on top of Qwen3.5 you can train and run on your own
repos.readme_snippet:
Kev
Small Jev-like decision models you can train and run yourself.
  
  
  
  
  
  
Kev is a family of small decision models built on Qwen3.5 and based on the architecture described in Jev's Architecture Unmasked. You can use the pretrained weights or train your own. The API matches TypeSafe's Syst
